FirstTimeUnitStartUtc.description: Start of the time interval, expressed as the timestamp for the start of the first [time unit](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/time-units), in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format.

LastTimeUnitStartUtc.description: End of the time interval, expressed as the timestamp for the start of the last [time unit](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/time-units), in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format. The maximum size of time interval depends on the service's time unit: 367 hours if hours, 367 days if days, or 60 months if months.
